VALIANTORG|20191231.context: VALIANTORG reported HALF-YEARLY through FY2020 under the BSE SME regime and moved to the main board only in Aug-2020. All 60 BSE announcements of calendar 2020 were enumerated: the only results filings are 2020-05-08 (half-year and year ended 31-Mar-2020) and 2020-11-13. There is NO Dec-2019 quarter filing at all, and the 2020-05-08 filing prints only half-year and full-year columns. So Dec-2019 and Mar-2020 became public only inside the Feb-2021 / May-2021 filings, and their announce dates are those carrying filings' dates (matching the stored annCon). Both source tables are SCANS with zero text layer - every figure was read visually from renders at 4.2x. Cross-filing triangulation, independent of the profit reads: the two quarterly standalone revenues sum exactly to the H2-FY20 standalone revenue printed in the earlier 2020-05-08 filing (14,451.43 + 13,377.12 = 27,828.55 printed), consolidated likewise (32,128.31), and 9M-FY20 std PAT 10,207.68 + Q4 2,185.05 = 12,392.73 vs FY20 12,392.74. Three filings agree.
